description: Generación de Energía en República Dominicana, 2001-2025 is a dataset listed in Dominican Republic national open data portal (datos.gob.do), an open data portal, published or maintained by Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONE). Este conjunto de datos contiene la Generación de Energía en República Dominicana de la Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONE), generadas en el periodo 2001-2025, en el cual se puede encontrar energía total por año. Coverage: República Dominicana. The portal files it under the publisher Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONE). Its tags are Energía y Sociedad, Estadísticas. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, ODS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-03-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-do-portal.
